profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Reliance Inc.
profile.summary: Seasoned IT professional with 18+ years of experience designing, building and supporting business applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
- Responsible for the development, and on-going support of custom applications and objects within Microsoft Dynamics CRM.
- Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) within all aspects of CRM software to include technical requirements, system configuration, user requirements, and system upgrades.
- Identify and implement third party applications to enhance and support the CRM system.

positions.title: Sr Application Developer/BSA III
positions.description:
-	Senior developer in System Services team responsible for designing, developing and supporting critical business systems including loan processing applications and all Corporate intranet websites.
-	Provide production support for enterprise-wide system integrations jobs using Informatica, IBM Business Analytics, SSIS, SSRS & JAMS job scheduler.
-	Coordinate with business users and QA team to develop test scripts and implement User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
-	Work closely with PMO to generate technical documents in support of system design, business process flows and timely delivery of critical business projects.
-	Key Contributions:
-	Implemented rewrite of the Corporate Asset Tracking web application using Microsoft ASP.NET 
MVC 5.0 with Entity Framework, Ajax, jQuery, Json, HTML5, CSS and Bootstrap.
-	Implemented third party integration to Human Resources application to streamline the on-boarding process.
-	Implemented critical upgrades to the existing Loan document management software to ensure compliance of the current banking regulations.

positions.title: Information Technology Manager
positions.description:
- Manage the System Development and Integrations team to design and develop over 40 integrations to merge ERP systems across the enterprise into a single worldwide financial system.
- Build Core Architecture for System Integration using service-oriented architecture (SOA) and object-oriented programming design (OOP).

positions.title: Team Lead - System Integrations and Development
positions.description:
- Design and develop customized .NET C# components to manage business rules and logic for all the integrations to extract, transform and load data into financial and CRM systems.
- Collaborate with stakeholders and business partners worldwide to ensure projects are delivered on time and within budgets.
- Provide world-class production support to enterprise-wide applications including an Expense Report System which is built on Microsoft ASP.NET technology.
Key Contributions:
- High performer with an excellent rating for the past three years exceeding management expectations. Nominated twice for Epicor IT Recognition Program.
- Successfully implemented SalesForce.com (SFDC) integration with our key Sales & Marketing System replacing the existing CRM System.

positions.title: Senior Application Developer/Analyst
positions.description:
Primary responsibility is for the ongoing support, maintenance, and enhancement of all existing and future Pivotal CRM (Customer-Relationship-Management)Software with more than 500 active users.
Secondary responsibility is for supporting efforts of requirements gathering and service requests for enhancements to all the Irvine Company divisions including Office, Retail and Apartments Communities.
Actively participated in the design and upgrade of Pivotal CRM 5.9 to 6.0 Upgrade
Received multiple Peer Recognition Awards for Excellent Customer Services, Effective Team Work and Excellence in Execution.
Technology:  Microsoft Visual Studio 2010, C# in .NET Framework 4.0, ASP.NET 2.0. vbscript, javascript.  Database Server, SQL Server 2005/2008, SSRS and Crystal Reports.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Actively involve in all phases of the system development life cycle including:
Gather user requirements by interacting with high profile clients and business analysts.
Design, code and test new releases and enhancement of the existing application
Work with DBA to develop database model and Entity Relation Diagram.
Provide world class 24X7 production support to international sites.
Technology:  Microsoft Visual Studio 2003, C# in .NET Framework 1.1, ASP.NET 2.0, ASP 3.0 (Classic ASP), vbscript, javascript. Database Server, Sybase adaptive server 12.0
